en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an ornate multi‑storey villa in late 19th–early 20th century eclectic/Art Nouveau style. The building has a tall conical turret topped with a cross, multiple arched balconies with wooden balustrades, and decorative half-timbering near the roof. A curved staircase leads to the main entrance, and a wrought‑iron fence with stone pillars surrounds the property. Two well‑dressed figures walk along a gently sloping cobblestone street in the foreground. The overall scene suggests an affluent urban residential district in Central or Eastern Europe.
